description: Co-Dialectic hooks — persistent survival + dev-cycle visibility + foundation invariant harnesses + auto-handoff before compaction. SessionStart auto-installs survival layer. UserPromptSubmit re-injects codi context + OS-grounded datetime (temporal-grounding harness). PreToolUse(Skill) emits plugin+version+scope banner. PreToolUse(Edit/Write/MultiEdit) fires the codify-or-mark-uncodified scan on .md files in invariant-carrier locations. Stop hooks verify the in-message status header liveness, fire the unit-of-work-commit reminder when workspace cwd has uncommitted changes, nudge skipped local verification / verify-access false blockers, and record never-blocking cost-routing nudges for next-prompt injection. PreCompact hook captures a deterministic pre-compaction packet + marker; SessionStart(matcher=compact) then delivers the codi-handoff reminder as plain stdout, after the summary exists and where the model can still act on it (XOS-259). TaskCompleted hook (v4.22.0+) runs the cross-family judge-panel cascade on agent-team task completions — opt-in via CODI_TEAM_JUDGE_GATE=1; exit 2 blocks completion and feeds jurors' flags back to the teammate.

statusLine._note: Claude Code reads statusLine from user settings.json, not plugin hooks.json. This entry is documentation — the install.sh / SKILL.md installer wires statusline.sh into ~/.claude/settings.json at install time.
